summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed Form 6-K announcing a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire ~26% (120,813,490 shares) of Brava Energia S.A. from a shareholder group at R$23.00/share, representing a ~27.8% premium over 90-day VWAP. The board of Brava has not yet provided a recommendation; no advisors named. The deal includes a subsequent Voluntary Tender Offer to secure a 51% controlling stake. Completion is subject to CADE antitrust approval, waivers from Brava's financiers, and successful tender. Funding is via a bridge loan. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and any competing bids that could shift the risk-arb spread.
